appPasswordsDesc: App passwords let older mail clients sign in without your main password. Each password is shown only once.
appPasswordsNote: Demo only: these passwords are generated in your browser and are not stored on any server.
demoAccountNote: Demo only: this Account Centre runs on a demo session in your browser. No real account is created and nothing is sent to a server yet.
devicesDesc: Devices signed in with this account. Revoking a session signs that device out.
forgotPasswordNote: Enter your email address. If an account exists, a reset link will be sent.
inviteOnlyNote: Public sign-up is not open yet. In Phase 1, sign-up needs an invite code. Without a code, no account is created.
passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters.
profileDesc: Your name, photo and recovery email for the whole suite.
recoveryPasswordDesc: If you forget your password, a reset link restores access to your account.
recoverySeedDesc: If you lose your seed phrase, old encrypted mail cannot be opened again. A password reset does not bring a lost seed back.
recoveryWarning: Password recovery and seed recovery are not the same thing. Keep them separate.
resetLinkSent: If an account exists for this email address, a reset link has been sent.
sessionsNote: Demo sessions only. Real session list comes from the auth service.
showOnce: This password is shown only once. Copy it now.
signInTitle: Sign in to your Dusrel account
twoFactorDesc: After your password, a second code from your authenticator app is required.
